Oneliner

Follow-on satellite to the Cute-1.7 + APD plus many improvements and camera.
Description

Follow-on satellite to the Cute-1.7 + APD Many improvements in particular, for amateur communications system, camera system, APD sensor, based on the experiences acquired in the development and operation of Cute-1.7 + APD. Redesigned satellite structure for increased solar cell area.
Notes

With a length of 2 Cubesat units and a height of 1.5 Cubesat units, it is not compliant with the CubeSat standard.
